notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (Sep. 22nd ~ Sep.27th)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg"]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

\[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : September 22nd (Mon) 00:00 ~ September 27th (Sat) 23:59 

※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times.  ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4) 

※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.  

Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on September 28th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from September 22nd (Mon) to September 27th  (Sat).



■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

\[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

\[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on September 28th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from September 22nd (Mon) to September 27th  (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

notes.title: Yiun’s Bingo Event (Sep. 15th ~ Sep. 21st)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/ff3e2460e2119d868ed328486005fe4286a209c1.jpg"]
From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Dragonians! Get ready to put your luck and skill to the test with Yiun’s Bingo Event!

Hunt monsters to collect Bingo Raffle Tickets and start filling your bingo board. Every 10 tickets gives you the chance to match a number and unlock exciting rewards.

Each match guarantees a reward, and even if your number doesn’t hit, you’ll still receive a prize! Complete rows and columns on your bingo board and yell “Bingo!” to score even bigger rewards, with bonus prizes for filling multiple lines.

Don’t miss this opportunity to claim a board full of treasures! Join Yiun’s Bingo Event during the event period and see how many rewards you can collect.

■ Event Period 
- September 15th, 2025 (00:00 UTC+8) ~ September 21st, 2025 (00:00 UTC+8)

■ Event Details
  - During the event period, you can obtain up to 50 ‘Bingo Raffle Ticket’ daily through hunting monsters.
(Note: Bingo Raffle Tickets cannot be obtained from monsters more than 40 levels below you or from Raid monsters.)
  - Click the \[Create Bingo Board] button on the event page to randomly assign numbers from 1 to 40 to a 25-square bingo board without duplicates.
  - For every 10 Bingo Raffle Tickets, you can make one draw on the event page. Each draw will generate a random number from 1 to 40 without duplicates.
   ※ If the drawn number is not on your board or the bingo board is already complete, you will receive a basic reward.
  ※ You can use Golden Key purchased with Gold to unlock up to 5 squares of your choice.

■ How to Participate
1. Click the \[Create Bingo Board] button to generate a board with random numbers from 1 to 40.
2. Use the Bingo Raffle Tickets obtained from hunting monsters to match numbers on your bingo board.
3. If you don't get the number you want through the draw, you can purchase a Golden Key to choose the number you need.
4. Continue drawing daily to complete your bingo board and claim a variety of rewards.

For more details regarding this Event, please check the notice on our official Forum. 
A link will be provided below
➡️\[https://forumadmin.mir4global.com/post/2218]

Thank You.

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4. 

We are here to inform you of the event ‘Exceptional Masters Portrait’ that is back again after 8 weeks.

This event is a ranking-based event concerning the following accumulation of collection points obtained from Dragonians’ cooperation in the same clan, and special buffs will be granted with the following ranking place.

Please refer to the information below for further details.

■ Period 
- Monday, September. 8th, 01:00 ~ Monday, September. 15th, 01:00 (Regional Server Time)

■ Item Deletion 
- Monday, September. 15th, 01:00 (Regional Server Time)

■ Details
- You can obtain 'Exceptional Masters Portrait' items by defeating monsters during the event period.
- Collection reward will be provided upon collecting 8 Exceptional Masters portraits and can be obtained 5 times per day by clicking ‘Obtain’ on the event page.
- ‘Legendary Blue Dragon Statue’ can be obtained as a First-time Collection completion Reward, and 1 'Painter Manho's Treasure bag’ will be obtained as a Repeat completion reward.
- If you lack a certain Exceptional Masters portrait, it can be exchanged in the Exchange Center on the event page and registration will be limited to once per try.
- Portrait Ranking will be reset at 01:00 (Regional Server Time) every day, and you can view through \[Menu] - \[Ranking] - \[Clan] - \[Collect Exceptional Masters].
- The ranking will be placed with the following accumulated collection points, and special buffs will be granted to the ranked clans for 3 weeks.

※ Portrait Ranking Reset Timeline 
- 01: 00 (Regional Server Time) every day

notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (Aug. 25th ~ Aug.30th)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg"]From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

\[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : August 25th (Mon) 00:00 ~ August 30th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on August 31th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from August 25th(Mon) to August 30th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

\[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

\[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on August 31th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from August 25th(Mon) to August 30th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg"]
From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

\[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : July 28th (Mon) 00:00 ~ August 2nd (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on August 3rd (Sun), Siege Eve will be from July 28th (Mon) to August 2nd (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

\[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing \[11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

\[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on August 3rd (Sun), Siege Eve will be from July 28th (Mon) to August 2nd (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Dragonians! Get ready to put your luck and skill to the test with Yiun’s Bingo Event!

Hunt monsters to collect Bingo Raffle Tickets and start filling your bingo board. Every 10 tickets gives you the chance to match a number and unlock exciting rewards.

Each match guarantees a reward, and even if your number doesn’t hit, you’ll still receive a prize! Complete rows and columns on your bingo board and yell “Bingo!” to score even bigger rewards, with bonus prizes for filling multiple lines.

Don’t miss this opportunity to claim a board full of treasures! Join Yiun’s Bingo Event during the event period and see how many rewards you can collect.

notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (Jun. 30th ~ Jul. 5th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : June 30th (Mon) 00:00 ~ July 5th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on July 6th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from June 30th (Mon) to July 5th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on July 6th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from June 30th (Mon) to July 5th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

notes.title: Yiun’s Bingo Event (Jun. 23rd ~ Jun. 29th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/ff3e2460e2119d868ed328486005fe4286a209c1.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Dragonians! Get ready to put your luck and skill to the test with Yiun’s Bingo Event!

Hunt monsters to collect Bingo Raffle Tickets and start filling your bingo board. Every 10 tickets gives you the chance to match a number and unlock exciting rewards.

Each match guarantees a reward, and even if your number doesn’t hit, you’ll still receive a prize! Complete rows and columns on your bingo board and yell “Bingo!” to score even bigger rewards, with bonus prizes for filling multiple lines.

Don’t miss this opportunity to claim a board full of treasures! Join Yiun’s Bingo Event during the event period and see how many rewards you can collect.

■ Event Period 
- June 23rd, 2025 (00:00 UTC+8) ~ June 29th, 2025 (23:59 UTC+8)

■ Event Details
  - During the event period, you can obtain up to 50 ‘Bingo Raffle Ticket’ daily through hunting monsters.
(Note: Bingo Raffle Tickets cannot be obtained from monsters more than 40 levels below you or from Raid monsters.)
  - Click the [Create Bingo Board] button on the event page to randomly assign numbers from 1 to 40 to a 25-square bingo board without duplicates.
  - For every 10 Bingo Raffle Tickets, you can make one draw on the event page. Each draw will generate a random number from 1 to 40 without duplicates.
   ※ If the drawn number is not on your board or the bingo board is already complete, you will receive a basic reward.
  ※ You can use Golden Key purchased with Gold to unlock up to 5 squares of your choice.

■ How to Participate
1. Click the [Create Bingo Board] button to generate a board with random numbers from 1 to 40.
2. Use the Bingo Raffle Tickets obtained from hunting monsters to match numbers on your bingo board.
3. If you don't get the number you want through the draw, you can purchase a Golden Key to choose the number you need.
4. Continue drawing daily to complete your bingo board and claim a variety of rewards.

For more details regarding this Event, please check the notice on our official Forum. 
A link will be provided below
➡️[https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2097]

Thank You.

notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (Jun. 2nd ~ Jun. 7th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : June 2nd (Mon) 00:00 ~ June 7th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on June 8th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from June 2nd  (Mon) to June 7th  (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on June 8th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from June 2nd  (Mon) to June 7th  (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

1. WEMIX PAY System Introduction
- The in-game Shop now supports direct purchases with WEMIX, replacing the previous pWEMIX$ system.

[May 27th Patch Note Details]

■ New Events
1. Cool 14-Day Check-in
2. Osher's Miraculous Fortune
3. Ancient Coin/Clan Coin Exchange Shop

※ Please refer to [Notice - Dragon's Cool Repaying Event Round-up] for further details.

■ Update Details
1. End of EXDRA Season 1
1) The first season of the seasonal token EXDRA, which ran for 24 weeks, will conclude with the update on May 27th. After a 2-week break, Season 2 will begin on June 10.
- In EXDRA Season 2, players can look forward to new Ancient Treasures and Special Magical Soul Orbs, as well as ‘Conquest Treasure’ that can be equipped to Conquest buildings.
- Detailed information about Season 2 will be provided in the June 10th Patch Notes, so stay tuned!

2) With the end of EXDRA Season 1, EXDRA1 token minting will no longer be available.
- EXDRA1 tokens already held can continue to be traded freely on PNIX DEX.
- Even after the season ends, you can still exchange their EXDRA1 tokens in the in-game Season Token Exchange Station for Ancient Equipment Boxes and Special Magical Soul Orb Boxes.

3) Materials for minting EXDRA1 tokens will no longer be obtainable.
- The minting materials for EXDRA1 tokens, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ and ‘Red Septaria’, will only be available until the June 10th Update. After that, they will no longer drop.
- The sources of ‘Red Nebula Powder’ and ‘Red Septaria’ will be gradually phased out as follows:

[Red Nebula Powder]
- Mission Scrolls and Monthly Check-in Rewards: From June 2025, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will be replaced with ‘Blue Septaria’, which is used for EXDRA Season 2 token minting.
- Limited-Time Products: Products containing ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will no longer be sold.
- Transference Equipment Enhancement Fail Rewards: Until the June 10th Update, ‘Red Nebula Powder’ will be rewarded. However, after the update, it will be replaced with ‘Blue Septaria’.

[Red Septaria]
- Power Score Rankings (All Servers): Ranking rewards will not be distributed until the June 10th Update due to the end of EXDRA1 minting.
- Disenchant Rewards: Until the June 10th Update, Red Septaria will be rewarded. However, after the update, it will be replaced with Blue Septaria.

4) 11 New crafting recipes have been added using ‘Red Nebula Powder’ and ‘Red Septaria’.
- Crafting is available through  Poipoi in Sanctuary of Hydra.

※ Please refer to [Pre-Notice: 2025, MIR4 NFT Transition] for further details.

Changes to MIRAGE Usage Following NFT Transition to WEMIX3.0 Mainnet

- To register an NFT to your MIRAGE Roster, it must first be converted to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet, just like in-game NFTs.
- If you currently have NFTs registered to ‘My Roster’ that were minted on the Tornado Chain, you can continue using them for activities such as entering Hidden Valley Capture, MiraX enhancement, and recharging Vigor without converting them to the new mainnet.
- However, if you seal a Tornado Chain NFT that is already registered in ‘My Roster’, you must convert it to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet in order to register it again to your roster.

※ If any errors occur due to continued use of Tornado Chain NFTs after the update, please follow the provided instructions to convert them to the WEMIX3.0 Mainnet before proceeding.

■ Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements
1. [Missions] Improved target quantity for gathering-related missions.
 - The required quantities for gathering-related missions (Plant, Ore, Energy, Darksteel, Box, and Void Orb) have been reduced, allowing for quicker mission completion.
2. [Craft] Fixed an issue where Dragon Materials would incorrectly display as 0, even when Dragon Materials were available, during equipment crafting.
3. Fixed an issue where the name and description of the buff granted by the Healing Tonic item were displayed incorrectly.
4. Fixed an issue where the effects of Mythic items among the obtainable items in the Black Dragon's Battlefield were not displayed.
5. Fixed various in-game typos.

notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (May. 5th ~ May. 10th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : May 5th (Mon) 00:00 ~ May 10th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on May 11th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from May 5th (Mon) to May 10th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on May 11th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from May 5th (Mon) to May 10th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Dragonians! Get ready to put your luck and skill to the test with Yiun’s Bingo Event!

Hunt monsters to collect Bingo Raffle Tickets and start filling your bingo board. Every 10 tickets gives you the chance to match a number and unlock exciting rewards.

Each match guarantees a reward, and even if your number doesn’t hit, you’ll still receive a prize! Complete rows and columns on your bingo board and yell “Bingo!” to score even bigger rewards, with bonus prizes for filling multiple lines.

Don’t miss this opportunity to claim a board full of treasures! Join Yiun’s Bingo Event during the event period and see how many rewards you can collect.

■ Event Period 
- April 28th, 2025 (00:00 UTC+8) ~ May 4th, 2025 (23:59 UTC+8)

■ Event Details
  - During the event period, you can obtain up to 50 ‘Bingo Raffle Ticket’ daily through hunting monsters.
(Note: Bingo Raffle Tickets cannot be obtained from monsters more than 40 levels below you or from Raid monsters.)
  - Click the [Create Bingo Board] button on the event page to randomly assign numbers from 1 to 40 to a 25-square bingo board without duplicates.
  - For every 10 Bingo Raffle Tickets, you can make one draw on the event page. Each draw will generate a random number from 1 to 40 without duplicates.
   ※ If the drawn number is not on your board or the bingo board is already complete, you will receive a basic reward.

1. Click the [Create Bingo Board] button to generate a board with random numbers from 1 to 40.
2. Use the Bingo Raffle Tickets obtained from hunting monsters to match numbers on your bingo board.
3. If you don't get the number you want through the draw, you can purchase a Golden Key to choose the number you need.
4. Continue drawing daily to complete your bingo board and claim a variety of rewards.

notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (Apr. 7th ~ Apr. 12th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : April 7th (Mon) 00:00 ~ April 12th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on April 13th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from April 7th (Mon) to April 12th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on April 13th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from April 7th (Mon) to April 12th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

- [Black Dragon Valley] 4F ‘Death Dragon Soul Chaser’

3. New Content: ‘Black Dragon's Battlefield’

1) Black Dragon's Battlefield is a new battlefield content where you can defeat boss monsters located in separate zones to obtain various rewards.
- Black Dragon's Battlefield is divided into a total of 15 zones, and you can obtain rewards through battles with boss monsters that appear in each zone.
- You can enter Black Dragon's Battlefield from character Level 95 and above, and can enter freely even after entering Floors 1-4 of Tower of Black Dragon.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/ff3e2460e2119d868ed328486005fe4286a209c1.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Dragonians! Get ready to put your luck and skill to the test with Yiun’s Bingo Event!

Hunt monsters to collect Bingo Raffle Tickets and start filling your bingo board. Every 10 tickets gives you the chance to match a number and unlock exciting rewards.

Each match guarantees a reward, and even if your number doesn’t hit, you’ll still receive a prize! Complete rows and columns on your bingo board and yell “Bingo!” to score even bigger rewards, with bonus prizes for filling multiple lines.

Don’t miss this opportunity to claim a board full of treasures! Join Yiun’s Bingo Event during the event period and see how many rewards you can collect.

■ Event Period 
- March 31st, 2025 (00:00 UTC+8) ~ April 6th, 2025 (23:59 UTC+8)

■ Event Details
  - During the event period, you can obtain up to 50 ‘Bingo Raffle Ticket’ daily through hunting monsters.
(Note: Bingo Raffle Tickets cannot be obtained from monsters more than 20 levels below you or from Raid monsters.)
  - Click the [Create Bingo Board] button on the event page to randomly assign numbers from 1 to 40 to a 25-square bingo board without duplicates.
  - For every 10 Bingo Raffle Tickets, you can make one draw on the event page. Each draw will generate a random number from 1 to 40 without duplicates.
   ※ If the drawn number is not on your board or the bingo board is already complete, you will receive a basic reward.
  ※ You can use Golden Key purchased with Gold to unlock up to 5 squares of your choice.

■ How to Participate
1. Click the [Create Bingo Board] button to generate a board with random numbers from 1 to 40.
2. Use the Bingo Raffle Tickets obtained from hunting monsters to match numbers on your bingo board.
3. If you don't get the number you want through the draw, you can purchase a Golden Key to choose the number you need.
4. Continue drawing daily to complete your bingo board and claim a variety of rewards.

For more details regarding this Event, please check the notice on our official Forum. 
A link will be provided below
➡️[https://forum.mir4global.com/post/2012]

Thank You.
