notes.title: Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event (Mar. 24th ~ Mar. 26th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/48808f7331d51bb6932727f99c9e33ab1f1a863d.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We hereby inform you of the return of the event ‘Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event’. 

Do not miss out this great opportunity to obtain a Legendary Magic Stone from March 24th (Mon), 2025, 00:00 (UTC+8) to March 26th, 2025 (Wed), 23:59 (UTC+8)!

Please refer to the information below for further details.

If you are a Dragonian who is willing to challenge this great opportunity, do follow the guideline below to summon Magic Stone through the firecracker-shaped tab > Event Summon! You will certainly get Legendary Magic Stone upon accumulating 300 points in the Event incense burner!

■ Period
- March 24th (Mon), 2025, 00:00 (UTC+8) to March 26th, 2025 (Wed), 23:59 (UTC+8)

■ Participation
1. click the event menu (Firecracker-shaped icon at the top left) after logging in.
2. Challenge for Summon on Event Summon > Legendary Magic Stone Challenge Event tab

- 110 Summons per day (counted as 10 times if summoned through 10+1) as a maximum, 330 Summons (Total 30 times if proceeding with 10+1 summons) will be available in total (1 Free Summon will not be included in the daily Summon count.)

- Daily count will be reset at 00:00 every day.
- Daily Free Summon will be provided 3 times (in total) during the event period.

■  Cost
Type: Magic Stone 
1 Summon: 100,000 Darksteel
10+1 Summons: 1,000,000 Darksteel

3. Obtainable items from the Summon will be as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/74d3db77f41398efcec20b889745988a0b18b900.png
- Legendary Magic Stone Box
- Epic Magic Stone Box
- Epic Sealed Magic Stone Box
- Rare Magic Stone Box
- Rare Sealed Magic Stone Box

■ Cautions
- You can certainly obtain Legendary Magic Stone/Spirit Treasure by accumulating 300 points in the Event incense burner if you failed to summon Legendary grade items.
- Accumulation will be counted for the Event Summon tab and will be increased per 1 point when summoning items graded below Legendary.
- Upon accumulating 300 points, touch(Click) the Event incense burner to obtain Legendary Magic Stone after deducting all accumulated points.
- The Event incense burner will not be affected by the point obtained from Combine Failure through Craft > Combine > Magic Stone.
- Event incense burner point will not be accumulated after summoning the Legendary Magic Stone  box.
- Event incense burner point will not be accumulated for Free Summon.
- Accumulated Event Incense burner points will be deleted after the event gets finished. (No effect on general Mystic Incense burner point)
- Please be notified that all Event Incense burner points accumulated from previous Legendary Magic Stone Challenge events have been reset when newly begun.

Thank you.

notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (Mar. 10th ~ Mar. 15th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : March 10th (Mon) 00:00 ~ March 15th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on March 16th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from March 10th (Mon) to March 15th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on March 16th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from March 10th (Mon) to March 15th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

notes.content:

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

◈Update Summary◈

■ New Events

※ Please refer to [Notice - Event Round-up] for further details.

■ Update Details
1. Boosting World Server Closure
- The Boosting World Server, which was introduced to invigorate the MIR continent, will be closed after 12 weeks of operation.
- All Boosting World Server exclusive events and Yiun’s Boosting World Mission Scroll will end.
- Characters transferred from the Boosting World Server will now have full access to all content, just like characters on regular servers.
- Upon the closure of the Boosting World Server, all Boosting World Server characters will be transferred to a random server within their respective assigned regions. Please refer to the table below for details:

2. Private Warehouse Expansion
1) The maximum expandable slots for the Private Warehouse have increased.
- Maximum Expandable Slots: 500 -> 999
2) Private Warehouse Expansion Tickets have been added.
- You can expand your Private Warehouse slots using Gold or the Private Warehouse Expansion Ticket.
*Even if you use the Private Warehouse Expansion Ticket items, you cannot expand your Private Warehouse beyond the maximum expandable slots.
- Private Warehouse Expansion Tickets can be purchased from the Shop.

3. New Auto-Promote System
- A new system has been added that allows Special Magical Soul Orbs and Ancient Treasures to be promoted automatically.
- You can set a Promotion Goal level, and the system will continuously attempt Promotion until the goal is reached.
* Special Magical Soul Orbs can be auto-promoted up to Lv.8, and Ancient Treasures up to Rare Tier 4.
- Promotion will continue until the Promotion Goal level is reached or the required materials run out.
- Materials used for Auto-Promote are the same as those used for regular Promotion, and all consumed materials will be destroyed regardless of the result.

4. Mystic Meow Haeryeong Special Summon
- Legendary Party Leader Spirit ‘Mystic Meow Haeryeong’ Special Summon has begun! 
- Special Summon Period: After the February 18th, 2025 Update ~ Before the March 18th, 2025 Update

5. New Legendary Spirits Added to the Legendary Spirit Stone Restoration Box, Legendary Divine Dragon's Spirit Mystery Box, and Combine Spirit Stones
- Newly Added Legendary Spirits: Thunder Divine Dragon Toril, Diviner Octy, Soothing Healer Haeryu
*Mystic Meow Haeryeong, Lookout Luna, and Celestial Guardian Eldra will not be obtainable from the Legendary Spirit Stone Restoration Box, Legendary Divine Dragon's Spirit Mystery Box, or Combine Spirit Stones.

Bug Fixes & Gameplay Improvements
1. Fixed an issue where the Taoist’s Moonlight Wave and Moonlight Orb skills hit more times than intended during Story Mode.
2. Improved the Request list to display Requests that cannot be progressed due to unmet prerequisites.
- If the prerequisite conditions are not met, the quest cannot be accepted, and a message stating "Requirements unknown." will be displayed.
3. Fixed an issue where some objects in [Elite] Underground Jail in the Sabuk Area spawned in locations that made them impossible to collect.
4. Improved certain Enhancement Stones by adding a [Use] button, allowing players to go directly to the corresponding Enhance screen.
- Affected Items: Transference Equipment Enhancement Stones, Divine Dragon's Dragon Artifact Enhancement Stone/Ancient Treasure Enhancement Stone
5. Fixed various in-game typos.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/977e96433b1e39c3bce2f1e4df80ae994361667a.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : February 10th (Mon) 00:00 ~ February 15th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on February 16th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from February 10th (Mon) to February 15th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on February 16th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from February 10th (Mon) to February 15th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

notes.content:

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Dragonians! Get ready to put your luck and skill to the test with Yiun’s Bingo Event!

Hunt monsters to collect Bingo Raffle Tickets and start filling your bingo board. Every 10 tickets gives you the chance to match a number and unlock exciting rewards.

Each match guarantees a reward, and even if your number doesn’t hit, you’ll still receive a prize! Complete rows and columns on your bingo board and yell “Bingo!” to score even bigger rewards, with bonus prizes for filling multiple lines.

Don’t miss this opportunity to claim a board full of treasures! Join Yiun’s Bingo Event during the event period and see how many rewards you can collect.

■ Event Period 
- February 3rd, 2025 (00:00 UTC+8) ~ February 9th, 2025 (23:59 UTC+8)

■ Event Details
  - During the event period, you can obtain up to 50 ‘Bingo Raffle Ticket’ daily through hunting monsters.
(Note: Bingo Raffle Tickets cannot be obtained from monsters more than 20 levels below you or from Raid monsters.)
  - Click the [Create Bingo Board] button on the event page to randomly assign numbers from 1 to 40 to a 25-square bingo board without duplicates.

notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (Jan. 13th ~ Jan. 18th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f0e1f1c2f820900b915f8994bf9c260f8876c031.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : January 13th (Mon) 00:00 ~ January 18th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on January 19th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from January 13th (Mon) to January 18th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on January 19th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from January 13th (Mon) to January 18th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

■ Update Details
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/70472bcf6f82eac039ccbfd61678259a976371fa.png1. New Growth Content: Descent of Divine Dragon
1) Descent of Divine Dragon is a new growth content feature that allows you to unlock Pressure Points using Dragon Materials and Dragonsteel, granting your character various stats.
2) There are six Pressure Points, each requiring different materials for unlocking.
- The materials to unlock the six Pressure Points are [Dragon Scale, Dragon Claw, Dragon Leather, Dragon Eye, Dragon Horn, Dragon Sphere].
- Dragon Materials can be substituted with the ‘Divine Dragon’s Key’ item, which can be acquired via Mana Dismantle or purchased from the Shop.
3) Higher-grade materials unlock higher-grade Pressure Points, with varying numbers of stats granted:
- Rare Grade: 1–3 Random Stats
- Epic Grade: 3–6 Random Stats
- Legendary Grade: 6–10 Random Stats
* Unlocking grants stats of grades C ~ B.
4) You can re-unlock Pressure Points to reassign their grade and stats.
- Re-unlocking requires the same materials as the initial unlock and cannot use lower-grade materials.
* Re-unlocking grants stats of grades C ~ B.
5) Stats assigned to Pressure Points can be readjusted using Aspiration.
- Materials required include [Aspiration’s Pledge, Dragonsteel, Copper]. Aspiration’s Pledge can be obtained via Mana Dismantle.
- The more stats assigned to a Pressure Point, the more materials are required.
- The number of stats assigned to a Pressure Point does not change during Aspiration.
* Aspiration grants stats of grades C ~ SS.

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Descent of Divine Dragon] for further details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f1b87988ca3717c2eeda0e68ca4b874e41223ae1.png2. New System: Mana Dismantle
1) A new system that allows you to dismantle Rare or Epic-grade equipment or Mana Beads to obtain various growth-enhancing items.
2) Mana Dismantle has six stages for each grade: Uncommon 1–6 / Rare 1–6 / Epic 1–6. 
3) The Dismantle Stage is determined by the Grade/Tier/Enhancement Level of the materials, with higher levels yielding better rewards.

※ Please refer to [Game Encyclopedia - Character] for further details.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/2f35d38acc4d61920de36c899be74ce574b44860.png3. New System: Dragon Artifact Benediction

※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on December 22nd (Sun), Siege Eve will be from December 16th (Mon) to December 21st (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

notes.title: Manual for Mainnet NFT conversion and the Marketplace
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/1cd6c8e915ff69ed618badf2210a0f630c09a128.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Through this notice, we will guide Dragonians on how to convert NFT Characters to a Mainnet NFT and how to use the renewed Marketplace.

Starting from November 26, 2024, Play Wallet Information must be transferred over to the WEMIX PLAY App to login to the in-game XDRACO function, XDRACO Webpage and WEMIX PLAY. Please check the video link below for further guidance.
➡️ [LINK]

Please note that NFTs that are not Mainnet NFTs can not be registered for sale onto the renewed Marketplace. Make sure to read this guide thoroughly and convert NFTs to a Mainnet NFT before using our service.

[Basic Information] 
■ Tornado Chain 
- A chain of tokens that contains MIR4 NFT; a new creation of NFTs and HYDRA/DRACO/EXDRA tokens will follow the Tornado Chain form.

■ Mainnet Chain 
- A driving force network of the blockchain ecosystem where you can use various services such as Marketplace, DAO, and De-Fi by converting NFT of WEMIX Mainnet through the Chain.

■ NFT Conversion 
- The chain of your NFT will change based on your needs (E.g From Tornado to Mainnet / From Mainnet to Tornado)
※ You need to convert (bridge) the Mainnet NFT to Tornado for gaming service.

■ Marketplace 
- A market system, renewed on September 11th, enabling the trading of all NFT(based on the Mainnet) serviced games or Blockchain services onboarded on WEMIX.
➡️ [LINK]

[NFT Conversion Types and Specialties]
1) Tornado Chain  → Mainnet
- Commission Fee : Free
- Gas Fee (in WEMIX) : Charged
- Precautions : NFT must be under Mainnet Chain upon registering for sale on the Marketplace of WEMIX PLAY

2) Mainnet → Tornado Chain
- Commission Fee : Free
- Gas Fee (in WEMIX) : Charged
- Precautions : NFT must be under Tornado Chain for gaming service.

[How to convert NFT]
① Click on the NFT you wish to convert to display the detailed information page of the NFT.
② Click the ‘NFT Convert’ menu in the detailed page menu.
※ There are two types of chain conversions: (1.Tornado Chain → Mainnet Conversion, 2.Mainnet Chain → Tornado Conversion) The conversion will commence depending on the Chain status of the NFT you wish to convert. 

[Conversion Method for Mainnet NFT]
① Notification message will be displayed upon clicking the ‘NFT Conversion Menu’.
② You can view the detailed notification message to convert the chain of NFT you currently own.
③ Upon pressing the ‘Convert’ button, the conversion will be initiated, followed by a signing process.
④ Upon a successful conversion, the Success notification will be displayed along with the gas and commission fee payment request.
⑤ Upon failure, the ‘Conversion Failed’ message will be displayed. 
  ● When converting chains, a Commission fee will not incur, however, a gas fee will be required to be paid.
※ NFT Conversion could fail if an error occurs during Chain conversion and if you do not have the sufficient amount for the Gas fee.
※ A signature is required when first converting Chains to link the Wallet with the Mainnet Chain, additionally, a Gas fee will be incurred. Converting Chains after the first Chain conversion will not require a linking process and will only require a signature. 

[How to view my NFT Chain Status]
① Click and access the detailed page of your desired NFT.
② Check the Chain Status in Details.
  ● Tornado= Can be unsealed in the game and is in a state where it is ready to use in the Tornado Chain.
  ● WEMIX3.0 = Is in a state where it can be traded on the WEMIX PLAY Marketplace in the Mainnet Chain

[Marketplace Detailed Information]
■ WEMIX PLAY Marketplace
 - A market system enabling the trading of all NFT-serviced games or Blockchain services onboarded on WEMIX.


WEMIX Mainnet
- You need to convert Tornado or PLAY chain NFT to the Mainnet for selling in the Marketplace.
- For gaming use, Mainnet NFT must be converted back to its original chain as Tornado or PLAY chain. (referred as Game Chain)


'English Auction’
- Buyer who calls the highest bids will take the targeting NFT in NFT Auction
※ The selling price will not be fixed in specific, and the tradings can only be completed by buyer’s offer and Seller’s approval through the auction.  


0.1 WEMIX
※ NFTs registered for sale can be canceled at any time. (Gas fees will be incurred)


- Your bid will be awarded if no additional bids have been input within the Seller's scheduled period after bidding the highest price.
※ Default hours will be set as 3 hours
※ Cancellation is not possible once a bid is made.


- Commission Fee: Gas fee per transaction will be required. 
- A commission fee (5%) will be charged upon completion of any trading.

[Marketplace Detailed Information]
- The [Offer] feature in WEMIX PLAY will not be available for MIR4 NFT.
- To trade MIR4 NFTs, they must be first converted to the Mainnet and traded on the Marketplace.
- NFTs can not be registered for sale with the PLAY Wallet App.
- NFTs will be put up for sale after 3 minutes have passed since its sale registration.
- Once all bidding is complete, click on the ‘CLAIM’ function to collect the sales proceeds and/or the MIR4 NFT.

Face the new NFT through the newly opened marketplace and experience the active NFT tradings and exchanges! 

Thank you.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f0e1f1c2f820900b915f8994bf9c260f8876c031.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : November 18th (Mon) 00:00 ~ November 23rd (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on November 24th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from November 18th (Mon) to November 23rd (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on November 24th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from November 18th (Mon) to November 23rd (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

notes.title: Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event (Nov. 4th ~ Nov. 6th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/87898d2f18204b94aee85999cf50bf5aadfade4c.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We hereby inform you of the return of the event ‘Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event’. 

Do not miss out this great opportunity to obtain a Legendary Spirit Treasure from November 4th (Mon), 2024, 00:00 (UTC+8) to November 6th, 2024 (Wed), 23:59 (UTC+8)!

Please refer to the information below for further details.

If you are a Dragonian who is willing to challenge this great opportunity, do follow the guideline below to summon Spirit Treasure through the firecracker-shaped tab > Event Summon! You will certainly get Legendary Spirit Treasure upon accumulating 300 points in the Event incense burner!

■ Period
- November 4th, 2024, 00:00 ~ November 6th, 2024, 23:59 (UTC+8)

■ Participation
1. click the event menu (Firecracker-shaped icon at the top left) after logging in.
2. Challenge for Summon on Event Summon > Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event tab
-110 Summons per day (counted as 10 times if summoned through 10+1) as a maximum, 330 Summons (Total 30 times if proceeding with 10+1 summons) will be available in total (1 Free Summon will not be included in the daily Summon count.)
-Daily count will be reset at 00:00 every day.
-Daily Free Summon will be provided 3 times (in total) during the event period.

■  Cost
Type: Spirit Treasure
1 Summon: 100,000 Darksteel
10+1 Summons: 1,000,000 Darksteel

3. Obtainable items from the Summon will be as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/c34e80eaab3697808fcbc2e27d544bed4d84515b.png
- Legendary Spirit Treasure Box
- Epic Spirit Treasure Box
- Epic Sealed Spirit Treasure Coffer
- Rare Spirit Treasure Box
- Rare Sealed Spirit Treasure Coffer

■ Cautions
-You can certainly obtain Legendary Spirit Treasure by accumulating 300 points in the Event incense burner if you failed to summon Legendary grade items.
-Accumulation will be counted for the Event Summon tab and will be increased per 1 point when summoning items graded below Legendary.
-Upon accumulating 300 points, touch(Click) the Event incense burner to obtain Legendary Spirit Treasure after deducting all accumulated points.
-The Event incense burner will not be affected by the point obtained from Combine Failure through Craft > Combine > Spirit Treasure.
-Event incense burner point will not be accumulated after summoning the Legendary Spirit Treasure  box.
-Event incense burner point will not be accumulated for Free Summon.
-Accumulated Event Incense burner points will be deleted after the event gets finished. (No effect on general Mystic Incense burner point)
-Please be notified that all Event Incense burner points accumulated from previous Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge events have been reset when newly begun.

Thank you.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f0e1f1c2f820900b915f8994bf9c260f8876c031.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : October 21st (Mon) 00:00 ~ October 26th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on October 27th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from October 21st (Mon) to October 26th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable

15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable

17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on October 27th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from October 21st (Mon) to October 26th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

notes.title: [Director’s Commentary] Rapid Growth Server & New Tokenomics
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/032e79c8422b869c84223e1f28d9d8b597d0fb2c.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is the MIR4 team.

Through this notice, we are excited to share two main updates planned to be implemented to MIR4.

In addition to the details of the development plans for the second half of 2024, shared through May’s Director's Commentary, the MIR4 team has been preparing updates to maintain the excitement and passion of Dragonians while ensuring the game remains engaging and fun.
Among the many developments in progress, we’d like to highlight two key updates designed to breathe new life into MIR4: the Rapid Growth Server and an innovative tokenomics system.

1. BoostingWorld Server (Planned for November)

We recognize that MIR4’s expansive content and varied growth paths can create significant progress gaps between new and veteran Dragonians. This disparity makes it harder for new players to find their footing in the game.

In order to solve this issue and reduce the strain and difficulties of growth for new Dragonians, we plan to prepare a server specialized for growth called the BoostingWorld Server. Anyone will be able to grow and become strong enough to enter battles and support your fellow Dragonians!

 A Server Specialized for Growth
The BoostingWorld server will offer tailored events and benefits that accelerate growth, allowing new players to catch up more easily and engage in battles alongside their fellow Dragonians. The server will operate for a limited period, after which characters can transfer to a server of their choice.


2. Innovating Tokenomics (Planned for November)

We’re also planning to introduce new tokenomics to complement the existing system, designed to enhance the value of the MIR4 ecosystem. 

Our goal is to strengthen MIR4’s tokenomics and ensure that the time and effort players invest in their characters are reflected in tangible value.


 New growth factor: ‘Ancient Artifact’ and ‘Special Magical Soul Orb’ added.
We are adding two powerful new growth items: the Ancient Artifact and the Special Magical Soul Orb. These items will play a central role in the new tokenomics and can be enhanced beyond the Legendary tier, up to Mythic. They will also unlock new passive or party skills, adding a fresh layer of strategy to the battlefield.

 Registry and Issuance of New Tokens
A new token will be introduced, serving as the key material for crafting the Ancient Artifact and Special Magical Soul Orb. This token will become the foundation of MIR4’s updated tokenomics ecosystem. Players will be able to acquire this token through gameplay, minting, reaching certain ranks in server-wide ranking events, or as a reward in the HYDRA Staking Program (HSP).

 Operated in a Season-based schedule
The new tokenomics will operate on a seasonal basis. Each new season will see the release of new tokens, ensuring that the total supply of tokens and items for that season is limited. This structure will preserve the value of tokens and items, even after the season concludes.

 Tokenomics Reboot
With the implementation of the new tokenomics, the following changes will be made to ‘HSP’, ‘MIRAGE’ and ‘EXD’.).
- Staking HYDRA in each season will yield the new season’s tokens through the updated HSP system.
- The number of Hidden Valley in MIRAGE will be adjusted to facilitate the supply of the token and to encourage the competitive aspect of the system.
- Ancient Artifact and Special Magical Soul Orb will become tradable on EXD.


This concludes our introduction to our upcoming key update plans.

We will provide further information regarding the mentioned updates and when they shall be implemented through a separate notice or through the patch notes.

We are also actively working on other updates mentioned in the previous Director’s Commentary and aim to release them according to schedule.

We appreciate the ongoing support from our Dragonians, and we will continue to pour our best efforts into improving MIR4.

Thank you.

The MIR4 Development Team

notes.title: Notice on Castle Siege Eve (Sep. 23rd ~ Sep. 28th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/f0e1f1c2f820900b915f8994bf9c260f8876c031.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We'd like to introduce upcoming event 'Castle Siege Eve'.

Castle Siege Eve is an exclusive event for the Castle Siege where players can root for the side that they support and gain special items before the Castle Siege.

※ You are able to receive the effect of Castle Siege Codex during certain period only, please refer to below details about Castle Siege Eve.

[Root for the Castle Siege with Drum of Victory!]

■ Event Period : September 23rd (Mon) 00:00 ~ September 28th (Sat) 23:59
※ Schedule will be based on Regional Server Times. 
ASIA(UTC+8)/INMENA(UTC+6)/EU(UTC+2)/SA(UTC-3)/NA(UTC-4)
※ It will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on September 29th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from September 23rd (Mon) to September 28th (Sat).

■ Content
- 'Drum of Victory' item can be gained through the hunting (Enable to acquire maximum of 100 pieces per day, initialize daily acquisition based on 00:00)
※ However, if the character's level and the monster's level differ between 20 or more, you are not able to obtain "Drum of victory" item even if you hunted the monster.
※ All of the Drum of Victory items will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 which is the D-day of the Castle Siege.
- You can cheer the side of which you wish to victory by using 'Drum of Victory' item within the event page(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
- 'Cheer' can be used 10 times per day and 60 times for maximum regardless of the side during the event period. The victorious side will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum'
※ 'Battlefield Drum' will give All ATK DMG Boost 3% and All DMG Reduction 3%, effects will be applied only on the Castle Siege area.
- 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Offensive Clan and 'Defense Kingdom Coffer' will be given if you cheer for the Defensive Clan. (1 item per 1 cheer)
※ You are able to gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' which can be registered in Codex with the certain chance.
※ You can gain 1 of the items listed below randomly by using Offense Kingdom Coffer or Defense Kingdom Coffer.
- Offense and Defense Kingdom Coffer have same components

[Components]
1. Vigor Pill (60 Mins)_Not Tradable
2. 60 Minutes Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
3. Copper
4. Energy
5. 3 Hours Speed-up Ticket_Not Tradable
6. Rare Oil_Not Tradable
7. Rare Snow Panax_Not Tradable
8. Rare Divine Water_Not Tradable
9. Magic Square Ticket_Not Tradable
10. Secret Peak Ticket_Not Tradable
11. Rare Noirsoul Herb_Not Tradable
12. Uncommon Mystic Enhancement Stone_Not Tradable
13. Epic Advancement Tonic_Not Tradable
14. Epic Greed Tonic_Not Tradable
15. Epic Prosperity Tonic_Not Tradable
16. Spirit Stone Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
17. Skill Tome Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
18. Dragon Material Summon Ticket_Not Tradable
19. Kingdom Codex Badge_Tradable
20. Kingdom Codex Badge_Not Tradable

※ Way to Participate Castle Siege Eve
1. After logging in to the game, click the Event menu (Firecracker shaped icon on the top left corner).
2. Select 'Castle Siege Eve' tab from the menu in the Event page.
3. During the Event period, you can gain Drum of Victory for certain chance by hunting in Field, Elite, Labyrinth, Hidden Valley and cheer Defense / Offense side 60 times for maximum. For each Cheer, you are able to acquire 'Offense Kingdom Coffer' or 'Defense Kingdom Coffer'(10 pieces of 'Drum of Victory' per 1 time of Cheer)
4. You can check the side who has won the Cheering Match on the D-day of the Castle Siege (Sunday 00:00)
5. The victorious side from Cheering Match will get an additional buff of 'Battlefield Drum' when the Castle Siege will be proceeding.
6. Enable to register acquired 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Coffer at Limited Event Codex.
-----------
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [1] : Accuracy+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [2] : Evade+15 => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [3] : Monster ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [4] : Boss ATK DMG Boost 6% => Kingdom Codex Badge*1
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [5] : Lucky Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [6] : Drop Chance Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*2
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [7] : Hunting EXP Boost 4% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [8] : All ATK DMG Boost 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [9] : All ATK DMG Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*3
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [10] : Skill Cooldown Reduction 2% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
- Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing [11] : Skill ATK DMG Boost 3% => Kingdom Codex Badge*4
-----------
※ Please read it carefully about 'Kingdom Codex Badge' and initialize exclusive Codex of Castle Siege
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is item that is able to register on 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing'(Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege)
- You are able to acquire Tradable or Not Tradable item of 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance.
- 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained 27 days for maximum
- You can register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' codex from starting date of Castle Siege Eve.
- 'Kingdom Codex Badge' is a permanent fix-term item. You are able to register remained 'Kingdom Codex Badge' to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex during any 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
- If you gain Tradable 'Kingdom Codex Badge', you are able to register it to codex or sell / buy it through the Market.

[Round-up of Castle Siege FAQ]
Q1) I can't acquire the Drum of Victory during the Castle Siege Eve event period.
A) You are able to acquire the Drum of Victory up to 100 pieces per daily during the event period.
Q2) I wanted to acquire the Defense Kingdom Coffer, but I acquired the Offense Kingdom Coffer by my mistake.
A) Those items have different titles, but the acquirable items through the Coffer are same.
Q3) Drum of Victory that collected during the Castle Siege Eve event period is disappeared.
A) You are able to use the Drum of Victory until Saturday 23:59 pm, it will be deleted on Sunday 00:00 am.
Q4) Is remained Kingdom Codex Badge deleted after the Castle Siege Eve event period?
A) Remained Kingdom Codex Badge is not deleted, you are able to register it whenever you want within the 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
Q5) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' Codex effect has been disappeared.
A) 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' is the fix-term codex, effect will be maintained up to 27 days from starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q6) I can't understand Castle Siege Eve event period and 'Exclusive Codex of Castle Siege' registration period.
A) Castle Siege Eve will proceed for 6 days starting from Monday to Saturday of the week before the Castle Siege.   
 Ex) If the Castle Siege is scheduled on September 29th (Sun), Siege Eve will be from September 23rd (Mon) to September 28th (Sat).
You are able to register 'Kingdom Codex Badge' item to 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' up to 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
※ Please remind that 'Bicheon Conqueror's Blessing' will be initialized after 27 days from the starting date of Castle Siege Eve event.
Q7) I can't acquire 'Kingdom Codex Badge' by using Kingdom Coffer.
A) You can gain 'Kingdom Codex Badge' with certain chance in the Kingdom Coffer. Also, you can buy it through the Market.

Thank You.

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4. 

Dragonians! Prepare yourself for the ‘Spirit Portrait Event’ where you can obtain special rewards and buffs during the event period. 

Collect 8 different, cute Spirit Portraits obtainable by hunting during the Event Period!

Freely Trade Spirit Portraits within your clan to be able to obtain the Spirit Portrait that you need!

Please refer to the information below for further details.

■ Event Period 
- Monday, Sep. 9th, 01:00 ~ Monday, Sep. 16th, 01:00 (Regional Server Time) 

■ Spirit Portrait Item Deletion
- Monday, Sep. 16th, 01:00 (Regional Server Time)

■ Event Details
- You can obtain 'Spirit Portrait' items by defeating monsters during the event period.
- Collection reward will be provided upon collecting 8 Spirit portraits and can be obtained 5 times per day by clicking ‘Obtain’ on the event page.
- ‘Legendary Blue Dragon Statue’ can be obtained as a First-time Collection completion Reward, and 1 'Shaoshao's Treasure Bag’ will be obtained as a Repeat completion reward.
- If you lack a certain Spirit portrait, it can be exchanged in the Exchange Center on the event page and registration will be limited to once per try.
- Spirit Portrait Ranking will be reset at 01:00 (Regional Server Time) every day, and you can view through [Menu] - [Ranking] - [Clan] - [Collect Portraits].

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

We hereby inform you of the return of the event ‘Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event’. 

Do not miss out this great opportunity to obtain a Legendary Spirit Treasure from September 9th (Mon), 2024, 00:00 (UTC+8) to September 11th, 2024 (Wed), 23:59 (UTC+8)!

Please refer to the information below for further details.

If you are a Dragonian who is willing to challenge this great opportunity, do follow the guideline below to summon Spirit Treasure through the firecracker-shaped tab > Event Summon! You will certainly get Legendary Spirit Treasure upon accumulating 300 points in the Event incense burner!

■ Period
- September 9th, 2024, 00:00 ~ September 11th, 2024, 23:59 (UTC+8)

■ Participation
1. click the event menu (Firecracker-shaped icon at the top left) after logging in.
2. Challenge for Summon on Event Summon > Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge Event tab
-110 Summons per day (counted as 10 times if summoned through 10+1) as a maximum, 330 Summons (Total 30 times if proceeding with 10+1 summons) will be available in total (1 Free Summon will not be included in the daily Summon count.)
-Daily count will be reset at 00:00 every day.
-Daily Free Summon will be provided 3 times (in total) during the event period.

■  Cost
Type: Spirit Treasure
1 Summon: 100,000 Darksteel
10+1 Summons: 1,000,000 Darksteel

3. Obtainable items from the Summon will be as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/c34e80eaab3697808fcbc2e27d544bed4d84515b.png
- Legendary Spirit Treasure Box
- Epic Spirit Treasure Box
- Epic Sealed Spirit Treasure Coffer
- Rare Spirit Treasure Box
- Rare Sealed Spirit Treasure Coffer

■ Cautions
-You can certainly obtain Legendary Spirit Treasure by accumulating 300 points in the Event incense burner if you failed to summon Legendary grade items.
-Accumulation will be counted for the Event Summon tab and will be increased per 1 point when summoning items graded below Legendary.
-Upon accumulating 300 points, touch(Click) the Event incense burner to obtain Legendary Spirit Treasure after deducting all accumulated points.
-The Event incense burner will not be affected by the point obtained from Combine Failure through Craft > Combine > Spirit Treasure.
-Event incense burner point will not be accumulated after summoning the Legendary Spirit Treasure  box.
-Event incense burner point will not be accumulated for Free Summon.
-Accumulated Event Incense burner points will be deleted after the event gets finished. (No effect on general Mystic Incense burner point)
-Please be notified that all Event Incense burner points accumulated from previous Legendary Spirit Treasure Challenge events have been reset when newly begun.

Thank you.

notes.title: Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Event (Sep. 2nd ~ Sep. 16th)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40990380/87898d2f18204b94aee85999cf50bf5aadfade4c.jpg

From my battle to our war, MMORPG MIR4

Greetings, This is MIR4.

Dragonians! There is something important you must keep note of during the 3rd Round of the Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Event!

Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Crafting with the permanent, limited-item ‘Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Seal’ obtained during the 1st ~ 3rd Round will no longer be available.
Please make sure to use all ‘Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Seals’ you have obtained before the Event ends on September 16th. 

After the Event end date of September 16th, Dragonians can no longer use the ‘Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Seal’ for Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Crafting. However, if you have some left, go to the NPC  Bae Yongyeok. 

For the 4th round of this event, we will return with the ‘Yellow Dragon Wayfarer's Badge’ Item instead of the ‘Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Seal’! The ‘Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Seal’ will only be available to use during this Event Period so make sure to move quickly to obtain the item that you always wanted!

For more details about the event, please refer to the information provided below.

- Yellow Dragon Wayfarer Seal can be purchased as a product from the in-game Shop.
